findings.summary: Anvil Studio is a Windows-only freemium digital audio workstation for MIDI and audio editing. It provides free core functionality for editing tracks via staff, piano roll, percussion, TAB, and event list editors. The software routes playback through a General MIDI synthesizer or assignable VST instruments and external MIDI devices. Audio processing relies on Core Audio, ASIO, DirectX, or WDM drivers. It supports standard MIDI files and uses MIDI event FF 7F to control rendering properties such as fonts, note positioning, and audio file links.

mechanisms.title: Track editing interfaces
mechanisms.explanation: Users edit individual tracks using dedicated editors — staff, piano roll, percussion, TAB, or MIDI event list — each providing distinct workflows for music-event manipulation.

mechanisms.title: Playback routing and driver support
mechanisms.explanation: The program defaults to a General MIDI synthesizer but allows track assignment to VST instruments or external MIDI devices. Audio processing is handled through supported driver types including Core Audio, ASIO, DirectX, and WDM.
